positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: iOS Software Engineer for the Google App.

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer (Contractor)
positions.description: Internal iOS app development for IS&T

positions.title: Senior Mobile Developer
positions.description:
I work closely with the developers in the mobile team on both the GasBuddy and Open Store mobile app projects. I was the lead developer responsible for deploying both the iPhone GasBuddy mobile app and the BlackBerry Open Store apps, as well as briefly maintaining the iPhone Open Store apps.

Assisted and mentored junior developers with whom I collaborate with to generate ideas and find solutions in our development.

Helped the company in implementing a version control system used by all the mobile developers and continue to act as the expert in it's use for the team.

positions.title: Junior Technical Architect
positions.description:
Introduced to iOS and BlackBerry development through joint project work on the MySask411 mobile apps through conception, development, testing, and deployment.  This involved planning the user interface for each platform, integrating phone features, performance tuning following core development, bug fixing, and persistent database management.

During the MySask411 project, I was also responsible for solo development on the desktop gadget and dashboard widget for Windows and Mac OS X, respectively.

Ruby-on-Rails web development for an internal web app with dynamic content and versioned article history.
Development and quality assurance testing for the SproutCore-based MyCentrex web app.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: During this summer term position, I performed independent research and development with agent-based networking and streaming video.

projects.title: OpenStore iOS Application
projects.description: iPhone and iPad mobile applications for convenience stores and gas stations. The applications are very flexible and highly customizable. They provide a location finder, feedback forms, digital coupons, loyalty programs, route planners, etc.
